title: Nifty Pre-Market: Global Pressure Meets Domestic Selectivity
onePageSummary:
Market Mood: BEARISH

Global Cues: S&P 500 -0.262%, Nasdaq 100 +0.133%, Dow Jones -0.616%, Nifty 50 +0.758%, Bank Nifty +0.006%, Nikkei 225 -1.024%, Hang Seng +1.682%, Shanghai Composite +0.518%, KOSPI +0.751%, Taiwan Weighted -0.552%, Straits Times -0.547%, ASX 200 -0.272%, US Dollar Index +0.192%, Brent Crude +6.456%
